subject: PO issuance request and line-item normalization for AtlasLogic
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlaslogic.com>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@atlaslogic.com
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 09:12:03 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / PO request: AtlasLogic

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for the quick intro earlier. Attached are our W-9 and latest product catalog to get the onboarding started. We need a PO number to proceed with the first shipment and would like the following provisional spend guidance: 50,000 USD/month (estimated).

Quick notes from our side:
- Estimated monthly run-rate: $45k–55k based on initial order cadence.
- Catalog SKU mapping included in the attached Excel (sheet: price_list).
- Tax docs: AtlasLogic_W-9.pdf attached.

Could you confirm the PO number and any spend caps or special invoicing instructions? We also noticed that the unit prices for SKU AL-450 and AL-452 are listed differently in your last intake form — happy to walk through that.

Regards,
Sanjay Rao
Head of Procurement
AtlasLogic
Attachments: AtlasLogic_W-9.pdf, AtlasLogic_Catalog_v3.xlsx

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlaslogic.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 11:04:21 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO request: AtlasLogic

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the docs and catalog. Welcome aboard.

Action items on our side before we issue a formal PO:
1) Standard vendor onboarding packet (I attached a filled checklist) — we need the signed vendor terms and confirm bank wiring details.
2) Confirmed tax docs received (W-9).
3) Line-item price confirmation for AL-450 / AL-452 (pricing mismatch noted).

Proposal: we can issue a provisional PO number PO-78921-PROV with a 50,000 USD/month spend cap while we normalize SKUs and finalize GL coding. If you need higher capacity during ramp, please send a short justification and a final line-item spreadsheet.

Can you send a clean line-item workbook with unit prices and suggested Redwood SKU mapping? We'll route it to finance for pre-approval.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Form.pdf

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlaslogic.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@atlaslogic.com
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 08:47:10 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO request: AtlasLogic

Thanks Vivek — attaching the requested workbook (sheet: final_line_items) and confirming the W-9 was included previously. A few clarifications:
- AL-450 unit price = $2,200 (previous sheet showed $2,000 due to promo line)
- AL-452 unit price = $1,150 (typo in catalog)

We would like an increased provisional cap of 75,000 USD/month for the first 90 days to cover initial stocking and anticipated ramp. If that requires an internal approval, please let me know which owner to loop in.

Attached: PO_78921_line_items.xlsx

Regards,
Sanjay
Attachments: PO_78921_line_items.xlsx

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 08 Jun 2026 10:15:52 -0700
Subject: RE: Vendor onboarding / PO request: AtlasLogic

Vivek / Marcus — I reviewed the workbook Sanjay just sent. Recommendation: approve a provisional spend cap increase to 75,000 USD/month for a 90-day onboarding window but enforce the following normalization steps before final PO issuance:
- Normalize AL-450 and AL-452 into Redwood product codes R-AL-450 / R-AL-452 (Marcus to confirm GL coding).
- Lock unit prices as listed in the attached sheet; finance will not accept retroactive price changes after PO is signed.
- Require AtlasLogic to complete the vendor bank info form (for wiring) and confirm 30-day net invoicing terms.

If Marcus signs off on the GL/GL mapping, I can approve the 75k.

—Neha

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlaslogic.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2026 15:24:06 -0700
Subject: Final PO issued: PO-78921 (75k provisional for 90 days)

Sanjay — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clarified line items. Per internal approvals (Neha + Marcus), we are issuing PO-78921 with the following terms:

- PO Number: PO-78921
- Provisional spend cap: 75,000 USD / month for 90 days (effective immediately)
- Locked line-item unit prices as per PO_78921_line_items.xlsx (no retroactive adjustments)
- Payment terms: Net 30, standard Redwood invoicing instructions will apply.

Attached is the signed PO (PO-78921_signed.pdf). Please confirm receipt and the expected first shipment date. After the 90-day window we'll do a final reconciliation and move to a standard annual cap if volumes stabilize.

On the GL mapping: Marcus, please confirm the mapping to R-AL-450 / R-AL-452 and notify accounting so invoices route correctly.

Thanks all — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: PO-78921_signed.pdf
